# Delta

The stat change.

`LL.Delta` · Components · Data

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Delta direction={…} value={…} polarity={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Delta" direction="{{…}}" value="{{…}}" polarity="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A stat change: glyph, sign and value, coloured by polarity (delta-better, delta-worse, delta-neutral).

## Props (DeltaProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` * | `'up' \| 'down' \| 'none'` | Which way the number moved: ▲ with +, ▼ with −, or none, shown as ±0 with no shape (Foundations · Shape). |
| `value` * | `React.ReactNode` | The size of the change, formatted, without a sign: "12%", "1.2s", "0". |
| `polarity` * | `'better' \| 'worse' \| 'neutral'` | Whether it helps the player. Set it from the stat's rules, never from the sign. Screen readers hear it as a word. |
